```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dotenv)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyr)
library(ieugwasr)
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(ggplot2)

# Read environment file

readRenviron(here("config.env"))

raw_dir <- Sys.getenv("rawdatadir")
interim_dir <- Sys.getenv("interimdatadir")
processed_dir <- Sys.getenv("processeddatadir")
resultsdir <- Sys.getenv("docsdir")

targets_file <- file.path(interim_dir, "predicted_outcomes/Drug_Bank_targets/Drug_Bank_targets.csv")
sig_snps_dir <- file.path(interim_dir, "predicted_outcomes/Primary_Indication_Mapping/Primary_Indication_Significant_SNPs")
harmonised_dir <- file.path(interim_dir, "predicted_outcomes/MR_PREG/MR_output_Sig_SNPs")
MR_res_dir <- file.path(processed_dir, "MR_PREG_MR_Results/Sig_SNPs")

MR_PREG_outcome_names_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "predicted_outcomes/MR_PREG/MR_PREG_Outcome_Names.csv")

```

```{r}
#| label: Reading in data
#| include: false

# Target of each drug
drug_targets <- fread(targets_file) %>% 
  filter(Primary == "Primary")

# Side effect of each drug - This will be the extracted side effects from reports

# Mapped Outcome data - This will include the MR PREG outcomes associated with the extracted side effects

# Significant SNPs for each drug
sig_snps_files <- list.files(sig_snps_dir, full.names = TRUE)

# Harmonised data
harmonised_files <- list.files(harmonised_dir, full.names = TRUE)

# MR output
MR_res_files <- list.files(MR_res_dir, full.names = TRUE)

# MR PREG outcome names
MR_PREG_outcome_names <- fread(MR_PREG_outcome_names_file)

```

# Drugs of Interest:
The drugs chosen were those with any suggestion of being harmful in pregnancy. These drugs were then filtered for those with instruments that showed a significant causal effect on the primary indications of the drugs. The resulting drugs were:

```{r}
#| label: Drugs_of_Interest
#| include: true
#| echo: false

drugs <- harmonised_files %>% 
  gsub(".*/", "", .) %>% 
  gsub("_MR_PREG_Harmonised.csv", "", .) %>% 
  gsub("_", " ", .)

knitr::kable(
  drugs,
  col.names = "Drug",
  caption = "All drugs with significant causal effect on primary indication and any suggestion of being harmful in pregnancy",
)

```

```{r}
#| label: Functions
#| include: false
#| echo: false

extract_targets <- function(drug){

  targets <- drug_targets %>% 
  filter(Drug == drug) %>% 
  select(c("Target", "Gene_Name", "Action", "Direction")) %>% 
  unique()

  if (nrow(targets) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  } else {
    return(targets)
  }
}

extract_sig_snps <- function(drug){

  sig_snps <- (grep(paste0("/", gsub(" ", "_", drug), "_"), sig_snps_files, value = TRUE)) %>%
  fread() %>%
  select(exposure, SNP, indication, Risk)

  if (nrow(sig_snps) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  } else {
    return(sig_snps)
  }
}

extract_MR_results <- function(drug){

  # Read in MR results
  mr_res <- MR_res_files[grep(paste0("/", gsub(" ", "_", drug), "_"), MR_res_files)] %>% 
  fread()

  # Add MR PREG full outcome names
  mr_res <- left_join(mr_res, MR_PREG_outcome_names, by = c("id.outcome" = "MR_PREG_Outcome"))

  return(mr_res)
}

create_plot_df <- function(mr_res){

  # Add binary outcome column
  mr_res$binary <- ifelse(!is.na(mr_res$ncase.outcome), "Yes", "No")

  # Adjust p values for multiple testing (per outcome)
  mr_res <- mr_res %>%
    group_by(id.outcome) %>%
    mutate(pval_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Align direction of effect to the direction of drug effect on the target
  for(g in unique(mr_res$gene.exposure)){
    drug_direction <- mr_res[which(mr_res$gene.exposure == g), "Direction"] %>%
      unique()
    if(drug_direction == "negative"){
      mr_res[which(mr_res$gene.exposure == g), "b"] <- -1 * mr_res[which(mr_res$gene.exposure == g), "b"]
    }
  }

  plot_df <- mr_res %>%
    mutate(
      OR = if_else(binary == "Yes", exp(b), NA_real_),
      lower = if_else(binary == "Yes",
                      exp(b - 1.96 * se),
                      b - 1.96 * se),
      upper = if_else(binary == "Yes",
                      exp(b + 1.96 * se),
                      b + 1.96 * se),
      outcome = factor(Meaning),
      sig = pval < 0.05
    )

  plot_df$gene.snp <- paste0(
    plot_df$gene.exposure,
    "(",
    plot_df$SNP,
    ")"
  )

  snps <- unique(plot_df$gene.snp)

  gene_cols <- setNames(
    scales::hue_pal()(length(snps)),
    snps
  )

  plot_df$fill_col <- ifelse(
    plot_df$sig,
    gene_cols[plot_df$gene.snp],
    "white"
  )

  genes <- unique(plot_df$gene.exposure)

  return(list(plot_df = plot_df, snps = snps, gene_cols = gene_cols, genes = genes))
}

create_bin_plot <- function(plot_df_bin, g, snps, gene_cols){

  df <- subset(plot_df_bin, gene.exposure == g)

  # If the drug is an inhibitor of the target, the plot will show decrease in exposure
  effect_direction <- df$Direction %>%
    unique()
    
  if (effect_direction == "negative"){
    x_label <- "Odds Ratio per 1 SD decrease in QTL"
  } else {
    x_label <- "Odds Ratio per 1 SD increase in QTL"
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      y = id.exposure,
      x = OR,
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper
    )
  ) +

  geom_errorbarh(aes(colour = gene.snp), height = 0.2) +

  geom_point(
    aes(colour = gene.snp),
    shape = 21,
    fill = df$fill_col,
    size = 2
  ) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +

  scale_x_log10() +

  facet_wrap(~ outcome, 
            scales = "free_x", 
            ncol = 2) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values = gene_cols) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = g,
    x = x_label, 
    y = "Drug Target Measure", 
    colour = "Drug Target Variant")
  
  return(p)
}

create_cont_plot <- function(plot_df_cont, g, snps, gene_cols){

  df <- subset(plot_df_cont, gene.exposure == g)

  # If the drug is an inhibitor of the target, the plot will show decrease in exposure
  effect_direction <- df$Direction %>%
    unique()
    
  if (effect_direction == "negative"){
    x_label <- "Effect Size per 1 SD decrease in QTL"
  } else {
    x_label <- "Effect Size per 1 SD increase in QTL"
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      y = id.exposure,
      x = b,
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper
    )
  ) +

  geom_errorbarh(aes(colour = gene.snp), height = 0.2) +

  geom_point(
    aes(colour = gene.snp),
    shape = 21,
    fill = df$fill_col,
    size = 2
  ) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +

  facet_wrap(~ outcome, 
            scales = "free_x", 
            ncol = 2) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values = gene_cols) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = g,
    x = x_label, 
    y = "Drug Target Measure", 
    colour = "Drug Target Variant")

  return(p)

}

extract_sig_SNP <- function(drug){

  # Extract harmonised exposure-outcome data
  harmonised_data <- grep(paste0("/",gsub(" ", "_", drug), "_"), harmonised_files, value = TRUE) %>%
    fread() %>%
    select(exposure, SNP, beta.exposure, beta.outcome, pval.exposure, pval.outcome, id.outcome, gene.exposure, f, r2, Action, Direction)

  harmonised_data <- left_join(harmonised_data, MR_PREG_outcome_names, by = c("id.outcome" = "MR_PREG_Outcome"))

  # Adjust p values for multiple testing (per outcome)
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    group_by(id.outcome) %>%
    mutate(
      pval.outcome_adj = p.adjust(pval.outcome, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Filter for significant SNP-outcome associations
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    mutate(
      sig = pval.outcome_adj < 0.05
    ) %>%
    filter(sig == TRUE) %>%
    unique()

  # Assigning risk due to drug target effect
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    mutate(
      Risk = ifelse(
        beta.outcome < 0, 
        "Decreased Risk", 
        "Increased Risk")
    )

  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data[order(harmonised_data$id.outcome, harmonised_data$SNP, harmonised_data$Risk),]

  if(nrow(harmonised_data) != 0) {
    
    return(harmonised_data)

  } else {
  return(NULL)
  }
}

```

```{r}
#| label: Drug_Results
#| include: true
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 50


for (drug in drugs) {

  cat("\n\n# ", drug, "\n\n", sep = "")

  cat("\n\n## ", "Side Effects", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # What are the side effects

  #knitr::kable(
  #  side_effects,
  #  caption = "Captopril Side Effects",
  #)

  cat("\n\n## ", "MR PREG outcomes are associated with these side effects", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # What MR PREG outcomes are associated with these side effects

  #knitr::kable(
  #  mrpreg_outcomes,
  #  caption = "Captopril MR PREG Outcomes",
  #)

  cat("\n\n## ", "Drug Targets", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # What are the targets
  targets <- extract_targets(drug)

  if(is.null(targets)){
    cat("No targets found for ", drug)
    next
  } else{
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(knitr::kable(
      targets,
      caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "Targets")), 
      sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  cat("\n\n## ", "SNPs that displayed a significant effect on the primary indication of the drug", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # SNPs that displayed a significant effect on the primary indication of the drug
  sig_snps <- extract_sig_snps(drug)

  if(is.null(sig_snps)){
    cat("No SNPs that displayed a significant effect on primary indication found for ", drug)
    next
  } else{
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(knitr::kable(
      sig_snps,
      caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "Significant SNPs")), 
      sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }

## MR Analysis Results

#Once I have a good data frame of side effects for each drug extracted from the reports, I can select/highlight the relevant MR PREG outcomes for each drug.

  cat("\n\n## ", "MR Results", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # Read in MR results
  mr_res <- extract_MR_results(drug)

  if(is.null(mr_res)){
    cat("No MR results found for ", drug)
    next
  }

  # Create a data frame for plotting
  plot_df<- create_plot_df(mr_res)

  cat("\n\n### ", "Binary Outcomes", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # Binary Outcomes

  plot_df_bin <- plot_df$plot_df %>% filter(binary == "Yes")

  for (g in plot_df$genes)  {

    p <- create_bin_plot(plot_df_bin, g, plot_df$snps, plot_df$gene_cols)

    suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(print(p)))

  }

  cat("\n\n### ", "Continuous Outcomes", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # Continuous Outcomes

  plot_df_cont <- plot_df$plot_df %>% filter(binary == "No")

  for (g in plot_df$genes)  {

    p <- create_cont_plot(plot_df_cont, g, plot_df$snps, plot_df$gene_cols)

    suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(print(p)))

  }

  cat("\n\n## ", "SNP-Outcome Association Significance", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # SNP-Outcome Association Significance

  harmonised_data <- extract_sig_SNP(drug)

  if(is.null(harmonised_data)){
    cat("No significant SNP-Outcome associations found for ", drug, " after multiple testing correction.")
    } else{
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(knitr::kable(
      harmonised_data,
      digits = 100,
      caption = paste0("Significant SNP-Outcome Associations for ", drug)),
      sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
